fullPassage: On the traditional family smallholding, labour and domestic life are more closely interwoven than they are in a mill town, where the industrial is one thing and the domestic another. Peasants have children, for example, for much the same reasons that anyone else does, but also because they will grow up to work on the land, take care of the elderly, and eventually inherit one's modest allocation of acres. As well as looking cute, they represent labour-power, a welfare system, and the continued survival of the farm. In modern civilisation, by contrast, it is hard to say what children are for. They don't work, for example, and some of them are not particularly decorative. They are expensive to keep and not always rational. Caring for them as infants is one of the most difficult forms of labour known to humankind. Given all this, it is surprising that the modern human species manages to reproduce itself at all. Yet again there is no question of the utility of children among peasants and tenant farmers.

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 keep의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: (A) keep = 유지하다(고용 상태 유지), (B) keep = 부양하다(생활비를 대며 기르다)
det.analysis:
❌ ① (A) 부양하다 — (B) 유지하다: 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ② (A) 보관하다 — (B) 유지하다: (A)는 사람을 보관하는 게 아님, (B)도 부양 의미
❌ ③ (A) 유지하다 — (B) 보관하다: (B)는 아이를 보관하는 게 아니라 부양하는 것
✅ ④ (A) 유지하다 — (B) 부양하다: (A)는 직원을 유지, (B)는 아이를 부양

questions.passage: On the traditional family smallholding, labour and domestic life are more closely interwoven than they are in a mill town, where the industrial is one thing and the domestic another. Peasants have children, for example, for much the same reasons that anyone else does, but also because they will grow up to work on the land, take care of the elderly, and eventually inherit one's modest allocation of acres. As well as looking cute, they represent labour-power, a welfare system, and the continued survival of the farm. In modern civilisation, by contrast, it is hard to say what children are for. They don't work, for example, and some of them are not particularly decorative. They are expensive to keep and not always rational. Caring for them as infants is one of the most difficult forms of labour known to humankind. Given all this, it is surprising that __________. Yet again there is no question of the utility of children among peasants and tenant farmers.

overlay.blank: the modern human species manages to reproduce itself at all

questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 현대 인류가 결국 스스로를 재생산한다는 것. 아이를 키우는 모든 어려움을 감안하면 놀라운 일.
det.analysis:
❌ ① children are always rational and decorative: 본문은 '항상 이성적이지 않다'고 했으므로 모순
✅ ② the modern human species manages to reproduce itself at all: 이 모든 어려움에도 불구하고 재생산한다는 것이 놀랍다는 원문에 부합
❌ ③ peasants no longer need their children: 본문 마지막 문장에서 소작농에게 아이의 유용성은 의문의 여지가 없다고 함
❌ ④ farming has become more difficult than ever: 현대 도시의 아이 양육 이야기이므로 농업 난이도와 무관
